H01.description: Passes the resolved npmrc to setup_npm_compat, a caller update for the registry fix.

H02.description: Imports ResolvedNpmRc, needed by the registry fix.

H03.description: Adds the pinned TYPES_NODE_VERSION constant that the @types/node pinning fix uses.

H04.description: Adds an npmrc parameter to setup_npm_compat for the registry fix.

H06.description: Adds an npmrc parameter to ensure_types_node.

H08.description: @types/node is downloaded at the registry's floating `latest` tag rather than a pinned version, and any copy already materialized is reused whatever its version, so type-check diagnostics can change silently or stay stuck on a stale version.

H09.description: Passes npmrc to the undici-types download.

H11.description: download_npm_package hardcodes registry.npmjs.org and ignores the project's configured registry (.npmrc / NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY), so private registries, mirrors and offline setups are bypassed.
